subject: Hosted API evaluation — scheduling & preflight
messages:
From: Maria Chen <maria@gloss.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: looking for a quick eval next week

Hi Naomi,

I signed up for the Hosted API evaluation via the self-serve flow and would love to schedule a short walkthrough next week. Our team is evaluating streaming latency and cost for an embedding-heavy search workload.

Ideal: 45 minutes in the afternoon PST (we’re on PST) — any day Tue-Wed next week works. If you have a preflight checklist we can run through ahead of time, send it over.

Thanks,
Maria
Maria Chen
Engineering Lead, Gloss.ai
[maria@gloss.ai]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Chen <maria@gloss.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: looking for a quick eval next week

Hi Maria — great to meet you and welcome to Redwood.

Thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused evaluation session. Quick note on format I usually follow so we use time efficiently: 10 minutes intro & goals, 25 minutes hands-on walkthrough (sandbox + hosted API patterns), 10 minutes next steps (pilot, Dedicated options). If you'd prefer a full 45-min deep dive into latency tradeoffs, we can extend.

I can offer these windows (PST):
- Tue Jun 29, 2:00–2:45pm
- Wed Jun 30, 4:00–4:45pm

If neither works, tell me two slots that do. Before the call it helps if you can:
- Share a brief note with the top 3 success criteria for the eval
- Confirm whether you need mock data in the sandbox or a small subset of production for throughput testing

Attached: Redwood hosted API demo prep (short checklist).

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
SDR / PLG Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-demo-prep.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]
From: Maria Chen <maria@gloss.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: looking for a quick eval next week

Thanks, Naomi — really helpful. The second slot on Wed Jun 30 at 4pm PST works for us, but could we make it 45 minutes instead? Our goals:
- Validate 95th percentile latency for streaming responses with 1–2k token outputs
- Compare tokens/sec and cost between two model variants and a quantized profile
- Quick sanity-check of embedding recall for a 50k doc index

We don’t need production data; a small synthetic subset will be fine. Also can you include whoever owns the technical deep-dive on your side (esp. kernel/quantization tradeoffs)?

Appreciate the prep doc — I’ll forward to my team.

—Maria
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Chen <maria@gloss.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API: looking for a quick eval next week

Hi Maria — I’m Diego, I run technical onboarding for Hosted API evals. Naomi, thanks for the intro. I can take the technical half of the session and we can extend to 45 minutes.

I went ahead and created a calendar invite for Wed Jun 30, 4:00–4:45pm PST (attached). Agenda: 10' goals & constraints (Maria), 30' hands-on (latency streams + quantization compare), 5' next steps & pilot scope. If you want a quick pre-call smoke test of the sandbox integration we can do a 15-minute hangout 24 hours prior; say yes/no.

Attachments: gloss-hostedapi-invite.ics (calendar invite)
Related note: if you want us to pre-run a 1k-token streaming trace, attach 1–2 representative prompts or a tiny corpus (anonymized).

See you on the 30th,
Diego Fernandez
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: gloss-hostedapi-invite.ics (ics, 3KB)]
